notes: Recorded 11 bachelor's programmes and study options (the page states six English-taught bachelor's programmes: Design and Media; Economics; International Business; Finance; Science and Technology with six study options; Technology, Business and Design) and 75 distinct master's programme names. The master's page lists programmes under several field headings and repeats some under more than one heading; each name is entered once with the headings in the detail. The page states no total; the earlier stored text said about 75, which agrees with this count (Industrial Engineering and Management appears with and without the (Technology) qualifier but links to the same study option, so it is entered once).

Names with a school in brackets, such as Game Design and Development (Art and Design) and (Technology), are separate study options on the page and are kept as written; "Fashion and Textile Design" is listed in Technology and Engineering as "Fashion and Textile Design (Art and Design)".

International joint degree programmes are not entered: the master's page says they have different application periods and requirements, and the scholarship page says certain joint degrees have their own tuition fees and scholarship schemes. The joint degree page for autumn 2027 names: NoVA (Nordic Master in Visual Studies and Art Education), CYBERSURE, REPLAY (European Game Design Masters), Communications and Data Science (Unite!), Semiconductor Chips Integration and Innovation, SpaceMaster, Bioceb, European Mining Course, Sustainable Urban Mobility Transitions, four EIT Digital ICT Innovation tracks and SELECT (EIT InnoEnergy). The pages do not say whether the Aalto Excellence Scholarship applies to them.
Bachelor's: the Technology, Business and Design programme is interdisciplinary; Finance is new for autumn 2027 per the earlier stored text.
not_stated: Which programmes award scholarships: the scholarship page says programmes may decide not to grant any and refers to each study option page for criteria.
A total number of master's programmes.
